description: Returns the signed-in user's profile: id, display name, description and country code. Call it first when the user wants to create content: it confirms the token is accepted.
name: get_current_user_details

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the user last opened the Pinsvit app in, else their home country, else the caller's network; pass it as countryCode to search_places.

title: Current user profile
